business_process: In-store checkout and card payment (98 core stores)
description: Lanes and self-checkouts ring sales and take card, cash, and digital wallet payments; card authorizations go through the payment switch to the primary processor
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $10.6 million of daily core-store sales; store-and-forward authorization covers about 4 hours within floor limits before fraud exposure and processor rules end it; customers leave full carts
manual_workaround: Store-and-forward offline authorization within floor limits for up to 4 hours; cash only after that; manager-approved check acceptance is not offered
dependent_third_parties: Primary card processor; SD-WAN carriers; POS software vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Cashiers and front-end leads; 98 core stores; payment switch team
quantified_impact_basis: About 65% of core-store sales lost once store-and-forward ends ($6.9 million) plus about $500,000 of abandoned perishable carts and overtime
single_points_of_failure: Single primary processor carries about 98% of card volume

description: SNAP benefit purchases at lanes; core stores route EBT through the company payment switch to each state EBT processor (third party processor role, 7 CFR 274.3(d))
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Households depend on benefits to buy food; state retailer agreements set downtime liabilities and manual voucher procedures (7 CFR 274.3(c)(4)); about 6% of sales
manual_workaround: Manual vouchers with telephone authorization under each state retailer agreement; store leads trained per state procedure
dependent_third_parties: State EBT processors (5 states); EBT gateway
quantified_impact_basis: About 6% of daily sales ($790,000) at risk, partly recovered through manual vouchers, plus regulatory and reputational exposure
acquired_banner_dependency: AB stores use the legacy processor for EBT

description: Web storefront and mobile apps: browsing, cart, checkout with hosted payment fields, saved-card tokens, order submission (about 9,900 orders a day)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $1.18 million of online sales per day; customers switch to competitors after a few hours; payment page integrity is a PCI DSS duty (6.4.3, 11.6.1)
manual_workaround: Phone orders are not offered; customers redirected to stores; orders already placed are fulfilled
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; primary card processor (hosted fields and SDK); content delivery network
quantified_impact_basis: About 70% of daily online sales lost ($830,000) plus delivery slot and marketing make-goods
single_points_of_failure: Hosted payment fields and app SDK from the primary processor

business_process: Online order fulfillment (picking, curbside pickup, home delivery)
description: Store pickers use handhelds to pick orders; pickup customers check in; delivery orders hand off to last-mile providers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Perishable orders and promised delivery windows; customers already paid; cold chain for delivered food
manual_workaround: Printed pick lists from the order management system; manual substitution calls; shift deliveries among providers
dependent_third_parties: Last-mile delivery providers A, B, and C
dependent_people_or_facilities: About 1,600 pickers and drivers; 98 core stores
quantified_impact_basis: Missed windows and refunds (about $420,000) plus perishable write-offs and redelivery costs
single_points_of_failure: Delivery provider A carries 62% of home deliveries

business_process: Store replenishment and distribution center operations
description: Forecast-driven orders, warehouse management at DIST-1 and DIST-2, transportation to 112 stores (including AB since 2026-02)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Perishables need daily deliveries; out-of-stocks build within a day; food safety for refrigerated loads
manual_workaround: Repeat prior-day orders; paper bills of lading; manual dock scheduling
dependent_third_parties: Warehouse management software vendor; carriers; refrigerated trailer telematics provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: 980 supply chain staff; DIST-1 and DIST-2
quantified_impact_basis: Out-of-stock lost sales (about $1.5 million) plus perishable spoilage and expedited freight (about $600,000)
acquired_banner_dependency: AB stores served from DIST-2 since 2026-02
single_points_of_failure: Each DC has one warehouse management instance

description: Item file, shelf prices, promotions, and markdowns published nightly from the ERP to POS, ESL, and web; dynamic markdowns from SYS-12
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Wrong prices at the register expose the company to scanner-accuracy complaints and claims; promotions are funded by suppliers; price file must reach stores before opening
manual_workaround: Stores keep the last good price file; manual price overrides by store managers for urgent errors; paper tags at ESL stores
quantified_impact_basis: Pricing errors, lost promotions, and supplier claims (about $900,000)
single_points_of_failure: ERP is the only source of the price file

description: Member lookup at POS and online, points, weekly digital coupons for about 3.1 million members
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Checkout continues without loyalty (offers fail open); members expect promised savings; supplier-funded offers have campaign dates
manual_workaround: Honor posted member prices without member lookup; reissue missed coupons after recovery
quantified_impact_basis: Supplier-funded offers not delivered and goodwill credits (about $450,000)

description: Case and walk-in temperatures, refrigeration controller alarms, and building management at all 112 stores and both DCs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Food safety: product above safe temperature must be discarded; refrigeration failures are discovered only through alarms after hours; health inspection findings
manual_workaround: Manual temperature checks every 2 hours with paper logs; local controller alarms; on-call refrigeration technicians
dependent_third_parties: Refrigeration monitoring vendor (cloud dashboard); refrigeration service contractors
dependent_people_or_facilities: Store managers; Director of Facilities Engineering; on-call technicians
quantified_impact_basis: Discarded perishables when alarms are missed (about $40,000 per affected store), estimated at 9 stores a day without monitoring
acquired_banner_dependency: AB stores use a different refrigeration monitoring vendor
single_points_of_failure: Vendor cloud dashboard sends all alarm notifications

business_process: Checkout and payment at the 14 acquired-banner stores
description: Legacy POS and PIN pads; card and EBT through the legacy processor over a legacy VPN
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $1.64 million of daily sales; legacy processor contract RTO 4 hours; no store-and-forward on the legacy POS
dependent_third_parties: Legacy processor; legacy POS vendor; legacy VPN carrier
quantified_impact_basis: About 65% of AB daily sales lost
acquired_banner_dependency: Entire process depends on the AB legacy stack until conversion
single_points_of_failure: Legacy processor link and one store server per store

description: Phone, chat, and email support for orders, loyalty, and refunds
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers with failed deliveries and refunds; incident notification call center if needed (P08)
manual_workaround: Overflow to the outsourced contact center partner; web status page
dependent_third_parties: Cloud contact center provider; outsourced overflow partner

description: Purchase orders, receiving, invoice matching, and payments to about 4,000 suppliers through the ERP and EDI
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Suppliers tolerate a few days of delay; DSD vendors deliver on schedule regardless
manual_workaround: Manual purchase orders by email to top suppliers; delay payment runs
dependent_third_parties: ERP vendor (SaaS); EDI value-added network provider
quantified_impact_basis: Late payment penalties, lost early-payment discounts, and manual effort

description: Time clocks in stores and DCs; biweekly payroll for 12,000 employees
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: State wage payment laws; employee trust; biweekly cycle
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll with adjustments next cycle; paper time sheets
quantified_impact_basis: Penalties, overtime corrections, and manual processing

description: Daily sales audit, monthly close, quarterly 10-Q and annual 10-K
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SEC filing deadlines; MTD drops to 48 hours in the quarter-end window
manual_workaround: Prior-period reports and manual journal entries
quantified_impact_basis: Late or restated filings; audit fees; reputational effect

business_process: Retail media and data clean room (SL-1)
description: Sponsored products and display on the web and app, offsite audiences, closed-loop measurement returned to about 140 CPG clients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client contracts promise campaign delivery and weekly measurement; about $110 million of yearly revenue
manual_workaround: Pause campaigns and issue make-goods; delay reports
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider B; ad server vendor; clean room software vendor
quantified_impact_basis: About $300,000 of daily retail media revenue plus make-goods

description: Store-level sales, inventory, forecasts, purchase orders, and deduction status for about 1,400 suppliers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Suppliers plan production and deliveries from the data; contract commitments to weekly data
manual_workaround: Scheduled file exports to top 50 suppliers
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider B; EDI value-added network provider
quantified_impact_basis: Supplier service credits and manual exports

description: Loss prevention investigations, CCTV recording (no facial recognition), alarm monitoring
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Video retention for investigations and claims; physical safety handled by local alarms and police
manual_workaround: Local recorders keep recording; guards at high-shrink stores

description: Schedules, shift swaps, onboarding, and HR case management
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Schedules are published two weeks ahead; changes can wait
